decisions.decision: Multiple recipients are represented as ordered To and Cc arrays on one notification message
decisions.rationale: CDT and SQMS require multiple recipients but not per-recipient delivery tracking.

decisions.decision: Calling applications own recipient selection and validation
decisions.rationale: CDT and SQMS already validate email addresses; duplicating validation in the generic engine adds unnecessary overhead.

decisions.decision: SQMS integrates through two metadata-driven definitions and a thin coordinator
decisions.rationale: The reusable engine stays generic while time-driven parent/child behavior remains coordinated through normal System actions.

decisions.decision: SQMS application remains authoritative for business records and allocation decisions
decisions.rationale: The workflow engine owns workflow effects, not SQMS domain data or contextual business authorization.
